latest.basis: Latest complete FY actual source for approved CFO/CapEx/DA carry-forward ratios, not a forecast.

forecastActuals.workingCapitalBasis: Arithmetic mean of five consecutive annual change-in-NWC/revenue ratios. Change in NWC = negative FMP cash-flow changeInWorkingCapital (includes other operating working capital); positive increases consume cash. Not a difference of only receivables, inventories and payables.

revenueProvenance.basis: Consolidated issuer revenue in the presentation and scope of the cited published current/comparative column; no provider numbers, synthetic half-years, gross-pay-in substitution, or unpublished restatement bridges.

limitations: D&A is the explicit disclosed expense or sum of separately disclosed depreciation/amortisation components, not EBITDA minus EBIT. Null means not reliably reviewed for this row/scope; never fall back to provider D&A.

Finance income/cost totals are separately labelled when reviewed; gross interestIncome/interestExpense remain null unless independently established as pure interest. Net finance disclosures are not gross interest.
EPS is actual reporting-currency units per share, not scaled by the record's monetary unit; retain published historical/restated share-denominator basis. Null diluted EPS is not an invented equality.

comparabilityGroup equality is a necessary safeguard, not permission to subtract periods across changed definitions; read row compatibilityNotes. Income taxes use expense-positive/credit-negative signs; netIncome is attributable to owners, not group profit including NCI.

Provider annual coverage is the annual_income endpoint. The income endpoint's Q4 observations are half-year residuals, not additional full financial years; no unsupported full-year rows are fabricated from them.

GP is explicitly reported in all reviewed periods, including old 'Turnover' labels; COGS is the actual cost-of-sales/services line. Casino-management revenue is not gross casino turnover and is never tax-grossed.
Restated FY2024 and H1FY2025 continuing results exclude the discontinued casino operation; original H1June2024 is not comparable. Parent NI and published total EPS retain discontinued profits.
